explanation: Number of answers that were encoded for this particular question
The name of the original YAML file in which the answers to this question were recorded
Gives a unique programmatic key for the topic; that key should not change even if the textual description of the topic is modified
The question text from the original encoding YAML files where multiple answers to that question were collected

description: were there discrepancies in the answers
explanation: Indicates, when ‘true’, that the encoded answers contradict each others. This involves semantic (human) judgment, so the value ‘false’ does NOT meant that all answers are textually identical.

description: Index of the correct answer’s column
explanation: Specifies which answer is judged to be correct in this encoding. The column of the correct answer is 9 + IdxCorrect value. Note that this file records only 3 answers do the original correct answer column might not be present in this file.

Lists what keys did the answers have, separated by commas. The software that produced this file may assume that the keys were all numbers, placed in order, so the AnsKeys for a question with 2 answers should be “0:,1:” and so on. The result MIGHT be incorrect of the keys do not follow this convention
The answer which was selected as correct in for this particular question. Its column is indicated by the value in IdxCorrect
The first encoded answer from the YAML file
The seconf encoded answer from the YAML file
The third encoded answer from the YAML file
